p5_b7.ocr: Epistatic interactions The mixed model fitted was used to determine possible epistasis by the analysis of the Background × Chromo- some (Allele) interaction (B × C(A)) which indicates possible QTL × background or QTL × donor segment in- teractions (Tables 5, 6 and 7). HD (p-value = 0.004) and PH (p-value = 0.050) showed significant (B × C(A)) inter- action. For HD, epistatic interactions were detected for the 3A and 6B QTLs. In both cases, the magnitude of the differences was greater in the Avalon background (34 °C and 21 °C on 3A and 6B, respectively) compared to the Cadenza background (16 °C on 3A and 9 °C on 6B).
